prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A surreal, high-contrast black and white scene set in a room where every surface—walls, floor, and ceiling—is covered in bold, hypnotic, swirling optical illusion patterns. At the center stands a solitary figure, dressed in simple, modern black pants and a white shirt, their posture slightly slouched and contemplative, as if lost in thought or overwhelmed by the dizzying environment. The lighting is even and soft, eliminating harsh shadows and enhancing the flat, graphic quality of the space. The camera is positioned at eye level, capturing the subject in full body from a slight distance, allowing the viewer to take in the overwhelming scale and repetition of the swirling patterns. The overall mood is disorienting and dreamlike, with a strong sense of visual tension created by the interplay of the static human figure against the dynamic, almost moving background. The style is reminiscent of avant-garde fashion photography or experimental art installations, with a focus on graphic impact, minimal color palette, and psychological intensity.
